[LIMP.4.1.2] A qualified reference joins the library to the
symbol with `.` at every use site: `ha.AlarmTriggered`. Bare
`AlarmTriggered` written without `from ha import
AlarmTriggered` does not resolve; `ha.AlarmTriggered`
requires `import ha`. A library is imported to be referenced
either way. In a type position the compiler **must** refuse a
qualified reference whose library the file does not import with
`DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_QUALIFIER`. In expression position such a name
is unresolved ([LGRA.22.9]).
